questions.question: A sample of milk contains 5% of water. What quantity of pure milk should be added to 10 L of milk sample to reduce this to 2%?
questions.solution:
Given:

Quantity of mixed milk = 10 liters

Initially, the quantity of water in milk = 5%

So, the quantity of water (in liters) in the 10 liters of mixed milk is reduced to 2%.

Calculation:

Let x liters of pure milk be added to mixed milk to reduce the water contained to 2%.

5% of 10 = 2% of (10 + x)

⇒ 0.5 × 100 = 2(10 + x)

⇒ 50 = 20 + 2x

⇒ 2x = 30 

⇒ x = 15

∴ 15 liters of pure milk should be added to reduce it to 2%.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 4)**.

questions.question: Three wires of resistance 3 ohm, 6 ohm and 9 ohm are connected in a parallel. What will be the total resistance of the circuit?

Three wires of resistance of 3 ohms, 6 ohms, and 9 ohms are connected in a parallel combination.

When the resistances are connected in series, the equivalent resistance is given by

R1 + R2 + R3 +.........Rn = Req

The equivalent resistance is greater than the largest resistance in the series circuit

When the resistances are connected in parallel, the equivalent resistance is given by

1/R1 + 1/R2 + ........ + 1/Rn = 1/Req

The equivalent resistance is lesser than the smallest resistance in the parallel circuit.

**Calculation:**

R1 = 3 ohm, R2 = 6 ohm, R3 = 9

(1)/(3) + (1)/(6) + (1)/(9) = (1)/(Req)

⇒ (6 + 3 + 2)Req = 18 

⇒ Req = (18)/(11) Ω

**Hence, The Total resistance of the circuit is (18)/(11) Ω.**

questions.question: A boy read (3)/(8) of a book on one day and (4)/(5) of the remainder on another day. If there were 30 pages unread, how many pages did the book contain?

Interval of four bells are 5 s, 6 s, 7 s, and 8 s

⇒ 840 s = (840)/(60) = 14 minutes
